description: Compile a PDF from server-saved project files using the project's compiler settings and an explicit entry .tex path. Use when the user asks to compile or needs a current PDF, not automatically after every source edit. Requires compile:run and Owner/Editor access. Reuses identical cached PDFs or active jobs, otherwise queues a new job under existing limits. Returns immediately without waiting for compilation. Use read_pdf with the returned jobId for progress and the PDF. Creates a job/artifact and history checkpoints without changing source files or deleting previous artifacts; no public publication or external recipients.

path.description: Project-relative entry .tex path, such as main.tex.

name: compile_pdf
title: Compile a project PDF
